title: Right adjoint of a composite
statement: Let $\mathcal A$, $\mathcal B$, and $\mathcal C$ be categories, and let $F:\mathcal A\to\mathcal B$ and $G:\mathcal B\to\mathcal C$ be functors. If $F$ has right adjoint $F^!$, $G$ has right adjoint $G^!$, and $G\circ F$ has right adjoint $(G\circ F)^!$, then there is a canonical natural isomorphism $(G\circ F)^!\cong F^!\circ G^!$. Under this isomorphism, the unit and counit of the composite adjunction are the pasted units and counits of the two given adjunctions.
